name: SKV
tagline: Hosted memory for AI agents, with event ids and a server-issued seal
description:
A hosted MCP memory server by Deniz Chavdarov.

Add SKV as an MCP server in Cline (do not open the endpoint in a browser — a normal GET returns 406). Use the https URL only.

What to try: save a fact in one chat, start a new chat, and ask for the memory event id plus the seal the server issued. Do not let the model draw a seal itself.

- Homepage: https://skv.network
- Connect guide: https://skv.network/connect
- Free private key: https://skv.network/profile
- Shared demo, wiped daily (put nothing private there): https://skv.network/mcp/k/demo/

Limits: it is hosted and run by one person. Self-hosting docs are not ready. The Chrome extension is still a beta zip, not a Chrome Web Store listing. There is no public user count.

env.name: SKV_API_KEY
env.description: Free API key from your SKV profile. Do not use the shared daily-wiped demo for private facts.

install.notes: Add SKV as an MCP server in Cline, not by opening the URL in a browser. Get a free key at https://skv.network/profile. A shared demo is at https://skv.network/mcp/k/demo/ — it is wiped daily; put nothing private there. Use https only.
